subject: S18 Settings: /settings/offline sub-route like /settings/ink
body: Unless you object: I add the Offline group as its own sub-route /settings/offline (component apps/web/src/offline/OfflineSettingsPage.tsx, same pattern as S12b's /settings/ink), one route line in apps/web/src/router.tsx and one item {id:'offline'} in apps/web/src/routes/SettingsNav.tsx (key settings.nav_offline). If your settings work moves/rewrites SettingsNav or the settings routes, keep an 'offline' entry pointing at OfflineSettingsPage and I'm happy. Tell me if you hold those two files.
